# Crealize

> Crealize LLC is a Tokyo-based independent product studio. We carry products
> from 0 to 1 — validate, build, ship, polish. Brand: "Creative × Realize —
> transforming imagination into reality."

Contact: support@crealize.llc
Languages: English (/), 日本語 (/ja/), 繁體中文 (/zh/)

## Shipped products

- PurityLens — AI skincare-ingredient safety scanner: photo → OCR → analysis (Flutter, AI OCR, Cloudflare Workers, D1)
- Fudeto — daily one-stroke puzzle game (Flutter, Cloudflare Workers, D1)
- Kichitto — receipt capture for solo founders: photo → AI OCR → auto-filed to Google Drive + Sheets (Flutter, Gemini AI, Google Workspace API)
- QiFlux — quiet, privacy-first cycle tracker (Flutter, Riverpod, Cloudflare Workers, Hono, D1)

## In development

- iDokuta — multilingual telehealth for foreigners in Japan (Flutter, 6-locale i18n, Cloudflare)
- Mairi — daily personal health record × hospital integration (Flutter, Next.js, LINE)
- Tendo — daily Hamiltonian-path puzzle, Fudeto's sister title (Web, Cloudflare Workers, D1)

## Method

Validate → Build → Ship → Polish. Stack: Flutter, Next.js, TypeScript,
Cloudflare Workers/D1/R2, AI integration (Claude, Gemini, GPT), CI/CD.

## Hiring

Remote-first, Tokyo HQ. Roles: Design, Engineering, Growth.
